steps.reason: Scope the full dataset for all accounts and channels — no date or amount filters are specified, so we use the entire transaction history.
Compute the per-account rapid in->out ratio (funds leaving within 48 hours of receipt) and rolling velocity features required by the rules engine and risk scorer.
Apply the rapid_movement rule to flag accounts where a high proportion of incoming funds exit within 48 hours — this is exactly the typology the query describes.
Broad query with no specific entity or threshold — anomaly scoring catches accounts whose rapid-movement behaviour is statistically unusual even if they narrowly miss a rule threshold.
Combine rule hits and anomaly scores into a ranked risk level so analysts can prioritise the most concerning rapid-movement accounts.
